senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;מזר , sec. r. of זר, cmp. מַמְגֻּרָה, מִמְכָּר, v. Arnheim Hebr. Gr. p. 173) [rejected, outcast,] bastard.
units: Yeb. IV, 13 איזהו מ׳ כל שאר וכ׳ who is a mamzer? The issue of any connection forbidden in the Torah; (oth. opin.) כל שחייבין עליו כרת וכ׳ the issue of a connection forbidden under the penalty of extinction; a. fr.—Pl. מַמְזֵרִים, מַמְזֵרִין, מַמְזֵי׳.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:13">Kidd. III, 13</cite> <he>יכולין מ׳ ליטהר</he> there is a possibility for the issue of bastards to be rehabilitated.
Yeb. VIII, 3. Y. ib. 9ᶜ bot. מַמְזֵירֵיהֶן the bastards among them; a. fr.—Fem. מַמְזֶרֶת.
